roles.solid: real material; two solids may never overlap
roles.void: opening / sleeve / pocket cut out of its own instance; things listed in `accepts` may pass through
roles.rebar: bar segment; allowed only inside its host (cover enforced), never through any other solid or bar
roles.clearance: soft zone (handwheel, access, bolt removal); intrusion = warning

rebar.note: stirrup touches main bar; same-set touching is normal. Set minCover per member (column 40, beam 30, slab 20, footing 50) in the rebar set.
